newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market rate up 70 bps to 10.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market rate up 70 bps to 10.1 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average money market rate added another 70 basis points to 10.1 percent on Thursday
Dealers said a meagre 28.9 million kuna in supply fell short of stronger interbank demand for term loans for a second day in a row.

One-month bank loans were struck as high as 17 percent, up from 12-15 percent previously. The interest for the rest of the morning's trade ranged between 8.0 percent for insurers' funds, and 10 percent.
Wednesday's overnight settlements shrank to 12 million kuna as only two banks borrowed money to square positions.

The National Bank of Croatia's kuna midrate for Friday firmed slightly to 5.4859 against the dollar while easing to 3.5632 versus the German mark. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
